user.title: Buy Me a Pie
user.description: Sign in with the login and the 4-digit PIN of your Buy Me a Pie account.

data_description.login: The login name shown in the app (Settings → Account).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The PIN for {login} was rejected. Please enter the current PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Buy Me a Pie cannot be reached.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for changes (at least 20 seconds).
data_description.show_completed: Shows purchased items as completed. Note: "Remove completed" will then also delete them in Buy Me a Pie.
data_description.auto_categorize: Items newly added from Home Assistant without a colour get a matching category (keywords and your own history).
data_description.category_in_description: Shows e.g. “2 · 🥦 Obst & Gemüse” below the item. The amount stays editable.
data_description.recipe_list: Recipes from buttons, NFC tags and voice commands go to this list. Default: the first list.

categories.title: Name the categories
categories.description: Buy Me a Pie only knows colours. Define what each colour stands for. The suggestions were derived from a real shopping history.

set_category.name: Set category
set_category.description: Sets the category (colour) of an item. It applies to the item name in all lists, just like in the app.

item.name: Item
item.description: Name of the item, e.g. oat milk.

category.name: Category
category.description: Colour number (0–28) or (part of) its name.

suggest_category.name: Suggest category
suggest_category.description: Shows which category the integration would choose for an item and why.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe to shopping list
add_recipe.description: Puts the ingredients of a stored recipe on the shopping list. Items already open on the list are not added twice.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name or alias of the recipe.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: Scales the amounts to this number of portions.

without.name: Without
without.description: Ingredients that should not be added, e.g. because they are at home.

todo_list.name: List
todo_list.description: Target list; default is the recipe list from the options.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Returns the ingredients of a recipe, or all recipes when none is given.

user.title: Add recipe
user.description: One ingredient per line, amount first, e.g. “500 g Hackfleisch”, “2 Dosen stückige Tomaten”, “Lasagneplatten”. Alternatively “Parmesan | 100 g”. Lines starting with # are ignored.

data_description.aliases: Comma separated, so voice commands find the recipe.
data_description.portions: Number of portions the amounts are for. They can be scaled when shopping.

reconfigure.title: Edit recipe
reconfigure.description: One ingredient per line, amount first.

error.name_exists: A recipe with this name already exists.
error.no_ingredients: Please enter at least one ingredient.
